children.name: Sphenoclea dalzielii N.E.Br.
children.description: A straggling annual herb with spongy stems and pink flowers, growing on mud beside pools and other wet, muddy habitats. It is an African species recorded from Senegal, Gambia and northern Nigeria, extending to the Ubangi-Shari region, and belongs to the small family Sphenocleaceae of succulent tropical wetland herbs. Described by N.E. Brown in 1912.
